newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares mixed, Solidere steady in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed while Solidere held steady on Thursday on increased turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange.
The BLOM index rose 0.01 percent to 896.53 and the LISPI index rose 0.10 percent to 81.88.
Banque Audi was steady at $18 for the third successive day on increased turnover of 32,434 shares compared with 23,444 on Wednesday.

Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, the other listed bank, rose to $12.875 from $12.75. BLC turnover rose to 17,435 shares including a bloc of 7,500 shares traded on the floor at $12.75. On Wednesday, 7,000 BLC shares were traded.
Solidere A shares held steady at $10.25, an alltime low, amid heavy turnover of 101,000 shares from 97,750 a day earlier.

Solidere B shares, which touched a record low of $10.25 on Thursday's first fixing at 0800 gmt, picked up quickly to close unchanged at $10.75 on the second fixing. A total of 36,400 B shares were traded against Wednesday's 27,850.
The shares were not affected by a sharp rise in the price of Solidere's Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) on the London Stock Exchange. The GDRs have risen to $12.8 from $11.05 since Friday.
Total BSE turnover was 187,269 shares for a value of $2,222,950 against 152,044 shares for a value of $1,736,730 a day earlier.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Ciments Libanais, Eternit and Uniceramic.
